light_management.why: Sets circadian clock, suppresses melatonin, boosts cortisol (healthy morning spike)
Even cloudy days provide 10,000 lux vs indoor 100-300 lux. Minimum 2,500 lux triggers SCN.

light_management.evidence: Gooley et al. (2011, PMID: 21415172): Room light suppresses melatonin by >50%

light_management.why: Blue light (460nm) most suppresses melatonin. Use blue-light blocking glasses or Night Shift/f.lux on screens.
Even dim light during sleep impairs glucose metabolism and cardiovascular function
light_management.evidence: Mason et al. (2022, PNAS): Light during sleep increased insulin resistance and heart rate

temperature.why: Core body temperature must drop ~1°C to initiate sleep
Paradoxically cools core body temp (vasodilation leads to heat loss)
temperature.evidence: Haghayegh et al. (2019, Sleep Med Rev, PMID: 31102877): Improved sleep onset by 10 min

temperature.why: Use cotton sheets, keep fan on, consider cooling mattress pad. Room temperature is the #1 sleep disruptor in Indian summers.

timing_consistency.details: Wake at the same time every day, including weekends (±30 min). This anchors circadian rhythm more than bedtime.
Within 30 min of the same time nightly.
Only go to bed when sleepy. If not asleep in 20 min, get up and do something boring in dim light until sleepy.

substances.guideline: Last cup by 1-2 PM (half-life is 5-6 hours; quarter-life is 10-12 hours)
substances.evidence: Drake et al. (2013, JCSM): Caffeine 6 hours before bed still reduced sleep by 1 hour
Fragments sleep, suppresses REM, worsens sleep apnea. Even 1-2 drinks reduce sleep quality by 24% (Ebrahim et al., 2013, PMID: 23347102)

substances.guideline: Avoid entirely, but especially before bed. Stimulant that causes nighttime withdrawal arousals.
Avoid within 2-3 hours of bed. Acid reflux and elevated core temperature from digestion disrupt sleep.
Reduce intake 1-2 hours before bed. Nocturia disrupts sleep, but don't dehydrate.

supplements.name: Melatonin
supplements.dose: 0.3-1 mg, 30-60 min before bed (low dose is key!)
supplements.evidence: Ferracioli-Oda et al. (2013, PMID: 23691095): Meta-analysis showed reduced sleep latency by 7 min, increased total sleep by 8 min
supplements.indian_brands: HealthKart, Carbamide Forte (3-10 mg tablets -- cut them; lower dose is more effective)

supplements.name: Magnesium Glycinate
supplements.evidence: Abbasi et al. (2012, PMID: 23853635): Improved sleep quality in elderly

supplements.name: Ashwagandha
supplements.evidence: Langade et al. (2019): Improved sleep quality

supplements.name: L-Theanine
supplements.evidence: Rao et al. (2015, PMID: 25759004): Improved sleep quality (not sedating)
supplements.indian_brands: HealthKart, NOW Foods on Amazon India

supplements.name: Chamomile Tea
supplements.evidence: Srivastava et al. (2010): Mild sedative, anxiolytic

it_corporate.typical_problem: Late commute home (7-8 PM), late dinner (8-9 PM), screen time until midnight, wake at 7 AM = 7 hours, but poor quality due to late eating and screens.

schedule.1900_1930: Light exercise / walk / play with kids
schedule.2000_2100: Family time / hobby (dim lights, no screens after 9 PM)
schedule.2130_2200: Sleep preparation: brush teeth, dim lights, 4-7-8 breathing

tips: Set hard boundary for no screens after 9 PM
Eat a lighter dinner to avoid reflux
Use commute time for self-improvement, not doom-scrolling
Morning sunlight exposure is non-negotiable for circadian regulation

night_shift.description: Night Shift IT Workers (7 PM - 4 AM or 10 PM - 7 AM). Shift work disorder affects ~25-30% of shift workers.

strategy.during_shift: Use bright light exposure (light therapy lamp, 10,000 lux) to shift circadian rhythm
strategy.commute_home: Wear blue-light blocking glasses (morning sunlight would reset clock to day schedule)
strategy.bedroom: Blackout curtains are MANDATORY (Indian rooms are often bright). White noise machine to block daytime noise.
strategy.meals: Fixed meals aligned to wake/sleep schedule
strategy.days_off: Try to maintain similar schedule (±2 hours max shift)

tips: Blackout curtains are essential for daytime sleep in India
Use white noise to mask daytime household sounds
Wear blue-light blockers on morning commute home
Keep meal timing consistent even on days off
Melatonin is especially helpful for daytime sleep

strategy.screen_cutoff: Stop screen work 30 min before bed; use notebook for ideas
strategy.blue_light_glasses: From 8 PM onward if working on screens
strategy.wind_down: 10-min Yoga Nidra if wired/anxious before bed
strategy.power_nap: 10-20 min, before 3 PM if sleep-deprived (NOT longer - causes sleep inertia and disrupts nighttime sleep)

tips: Sleep is an investment, not a luxury - it improves decision-making and creativity
Keep a notebook by bed for ideas instead of using phone
Power naps should be 10-20 minutes only, before 3 PM
Even on tight deadlines, protect your 7.5-hour sleep window

sleep_architecture.description: NREM Stages 1-3 (increasingly deep) + REM sleep. A full cycle is ~90 minutes.
sleep_architecture.nrem_stage_2: Onset of true sleep, body temperature drops, heart rate slows (10-25 min)
sleep_architecture.nrem_stage_3: Deep/slow-wave sleep, crucial for physical recovery and immune function (20-40 min)
sleep_architecture.rem: Rapid eye movement, dreaming, memory consolidation, emotional processing (10-60 min, increasing through the night)

circadian_rhythm.description: Governed by the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN), synchronized by light exposure
circadian_rhythm.key_zeitgeber: Light (most powerful), temperature, meals, exercise, social interaction
